```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r load-helpers, include=FALSE}
here_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input()))
source(file.path(here_dir, "profile_data.R"))
source(file.path(here_dir, "plot_theme.R"))
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
data_path <- params$data_path
df <- load_dataset(data_path)
profile <- profile_dataset(df)
```

## Dataset Overview

```{r overview-table}
overview <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Source file", "Rows", "Columns", "Total missing cells"),
  Value = c(
    basename(data_path),
    nrow(df),
    ncol(df),
    sum(sapply(df, function(col) sum(is.na(col))))
  )
)
knitr::kable(overview)
```

## Detected Column Types

```{r type-table}
type_table <- data.frame(
  Column = profile$column,
  Type = profile$type,
  Missing = sapply(profile$stats, function(s) s$missing)
)
knitr::kable(type_table)
```

## Per-Column Univariate Plots

```{r univariate-plots, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(profile))) {
  col_name <- profile$column[i]
  col_type <- profile$type[i]
  col_stats <- profile$stats[[i]]
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", col_name))

  if (col_type == "identifier_text") {
    cat(sprintf(
      "`%s` looks like an identifier/text column (%d unique values out of %d rows) and is excluded from plotting.\n\n",
      col_name, col_stats$n_unique, col_stats$n
    ))
    next
  }

  if (col_type %in% c("numeric_continuous", "numeric_discrete")) {
    narrative <- sprintf(
      "`%s` is %s, ranging from %.2f to %.2f (mean %.2f, median %.2f, %d outlier(s) by the IQR rule).",
      col_name,
      if (col_type == "numeric_discrete") "discrete numeric (count-like)" else "continuous numeric",
      col_stats$min, col_stats$max, col_stats$mean, col_stats$median, col_stats$n_outliers
    )
    cat(narrative, "\n\n")

    p_hist <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[col_name]])) +
      geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30,
                      fill = okabe_ito_palette[1], color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
      geom_density(color = okabe_ito_palette[5], linewidth = 1) +
      theme_dataviz_explorer() +
      labs(title = paste("Distribution of", col_name), x = col_name, y = "Density")

    p_box <- ggplot(df, aes(y = .data[[col_name]])) +
      geom_boxplot(fill = okabe_ito_palette[2], alpha = 0.9) +
      theme_dataviz_explorer() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
      labs(title = paste("Boxplot of", col_name), y = col_name, x = NULL)

    print(p_hist + p_box)
    cat("\n\n")
  } else if (col_type %in% c("categorical", "binary", "ordinal")) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "`%s` is a %s variable with %d level(s); most frequent value is `%s`.",
      col_name, col_type, col_stats$n_levels, col_stats$mode
    ), "\n\n")

    plot_df <- as.data.frame(table(df[[col_name]]))
    names(plot_df) <- c("level", "count")
    if (col_type != "ordinal") {
      plot_df <- plot_df[order(-plot_df$count), ]
      plot_df$level <- factor(plot_df$level, levels = plot_df$level)
    }

    p_bar <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = level, y = count, fill = level)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_fill_dataviz_discrete() +
      theme_dataviz_explorer() +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      labs(title = paste("Counts of", col_name), x = col_name, y = "Count")

    if (nrow(plot_df) > 8) {
      p_bar <- p_bar + coord_flip()
    }
    print(p_bar)
    cat("\n\n")
  } else if (col_type == "datetime") {
    cat(sprintf(
      "`%s` spans %s to %s (%.0f days).",
      col_name, as.character(col_stats$min), as.character(col_stats$max), col_stats$range_days
    ), "\n\n")
    p_time <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[col_name]])) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = okabe_ito_palette[3], color = "white") +
      theme_dataviz_explorer() +
      labs(title = paste("Timeline of", col_name), x = col_name, y = "Count")
    print(p_time)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Relationships Between Columns

```{r bivariate-plots, results='asis'}
numeric_cols <- profile$column[profile$type %in% c("numeric_continuous", "numeric_discrete")]
categorical_cols <- profile$column[profile$type %in% c("categorical", "binary", "ordinal")]

MAX_NUMERIC_PAIRS_COLS <- 6  # cap to avoid combinatorial blow-up on wide datasets
# knitr fixes fig.width/fig.height per chunk rather than per print() call, so a
# scratch dir + ggsave() is used to give the pairwise scatter grid a height
# that scales with its row count (avoids squashed/illegible panels).
dyn_fig_dir <- file.path(here_dir, paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input())), "_dynfigs"))
dir.create(dyn_fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (length(numeric_cols) >= 2) {
  cat("### Correlation Among Numeric Columns\n\n")
  numeric_subset <- numeric_cols[seq_len(min(length(numeric_cols), MAX_NUMERIC_PAIRS_COLS))]
  cor_mat <- cor(df[, numeric_subset], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat))
  names(cor_df) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Correlation")
  p_heat <- ggplot(cor_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(Correlation), "", sprintf("%.2f", Correlation))), color = "white", size = 3) +
    scale_fill_dataviz_continuous() +
    theme_dataviz_explorer() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = "Correlation heatmap", x = NULL, y = NULL)
  print(p_heat)
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("### Pairwise Scatter Plots\n\n")
  pairs_list <- combn(numeric_subset, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  plots <- lapply(pairs_list, function(pair) {
    ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[pair[1]]], y = .data[[pair[2]]])) +
      geom_point(color = okabe_ito_palette[5], alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, color = okabe_ito_palette[6], se = FALSE) +
      theme_dataviz_explorer() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = ggplot2::rel(0.75))) +
      labs(title = paste(pair[1], "vs", pair[2]))
  })
  n_cols_grid <- min(3, length(plots))
  n_rows_grid <- ceiling(length(plots) / n_cols_grid)
  scatter_grid <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = n_cols_grid)
  scatter_file <- file.path(dyn_fig_dir, "pairwise-scatter.png")
  ggsave(scatter_file, plot = scatter_grid, width = 9,
         height = max(3, n_rows_grid * 2.6), dpi = 96)
  cat(sprintf("![Pairwise scatter plots](%s)\n\n", scatter_file))
  cat("\n\n")
}

if (length(numeric_cols) >= 1 && length(categorical_cols) >= 1) {
  cat("### Numeric Distributions by Category\n\n")
  for (num_col in numeric_cols[seq_len(min(length(numeric_cols), 4))]) {
    for (cat_col in categorical_cols[seq_len(min(length(categorical_cols), 2))]) {
      cat(sprintf("#### %s by %s\n\n", num_col, cat_col))
      # categorical/binary columns are often stored as numeric (e.g. 0/1) or
      # character; coerce to factor so ggplot treats them as discrete groups
      # rather than a single continuous axis.
      plot_df <- df
      plot_df[[cat_col]] <- factor(plot_df[[cat_col]])
      p_violin <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[cat_col]], y = .data[[num_col]], fill = .data[[cat_col]])) +
        geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
        scale_fill_dataviz_discrete() +
        theme_dataviz_explorer() +
        theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
        labs(title = paste(num_col, "by", cat_col))
      print(p_violin)
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}

if (length(categorical_cols) >= 2) {
  cat("### Categorical vs Categorical\n\n")
  cat_pairs <- combn(categorical_cols[seq_len(min(length(categorical_cols), 4))], 2, simplify = FALSE)
  for (pair in cat_pairs) {
    cat(sprintf("#### %s vs %s\n\n", pair[1], pair[2]))
    # coerce both columns to factor for the same reason as above.
    plot_df <- df
    plot_df[[pair[1]]] <- factor(plot_df[[pair[1]]])
    plot_df[[pair[2]]] <- factor(plot_df[[pair[2]]])
    p_grouped <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[pair[1]]], fill = .data[[pair[2]]])) +
      geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
      scale_fill_dataviz_discrete() +
      theme_dataviz_explorer() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = paste(pair[1], "vs", pair[2]), y = "Count")
    print(p_grouped)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Summary

```{r closing-summary, results='asis'}
n_numeric <- length(numeric_cols)
n_categorical <- length(categorical_cols)
n_identifier <- sum(profile$type == "identifier_text")
cat(sprintf(
  "This dataset has **%d rows** and **%d columns**: %d numeric, %d categorical/binary/ordinal, and %d identifier/text column(s) excluded from plotting. Consider exploring outliers flagged above, and any strong correlations or grouped differences shown in the relationship plots.\n",
  nrow(df), ncol(df), n_numeric, n_categorical, n_identifier
))
```
